# Third-party browser assets

The RSIHub experiment viewer redistributes the following pinned browser builds
so artifact previews work without a network connection.

## Diff2Html 3.4.56

- Source: https://github.com/rtfpessoa/diff2html
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/diff2html/v/3.4.56
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.diff2html`
- Distributed files: `diff2html.min.js`, `diff2html.min.css`

## highlight.js 11.11.1

- Source: https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@highlightjs/cdn-assets/v/11.11.1
- License: BSD 3-Clause; see `LICENSE.highlight.js`
- Distributed files: `highlight.min.js`, `highlight-github.min.css`
